resume: Twelve years in hospital operations. job_description: The Vice President of Clinical Operations oversees surgical services, emergency, inpatient nursing, and ancillary departments across two hospitals. Responsibilities: operating margin accountability, physician partnership, workforce stability, quality and patient safety outcomes, and execution of the system's three-year strategic plan.
